scope: Independent adversarial review of the candidate diff, surrounding native inventory/click paths, and tests
second_model: User explicitly declined; same-model independent reviewer used

findings.issue: Changing native MaxCharges to -1 retained noncharged swords after quantity-based deletion
findings.resolution: Preserve native MaxCharges; project unlimited charges only in RoF2 serialization
findings.evidence: Actual InventoryProfile::DeleteItem regression reproduced the failure and passes for all six Avenger/Defender definitions in both grips

findings.issue: Oversized packet inventory slots could alias a carried slot through int16 narrowing
findings.resolution: Reject invalid slots before both ItemVerifyRequest and item/potion CastSpell normal paths
findings.evidence: Actual packet guard blocks execute against negative/oversized aliases, supported/unsupported valid items and unaffected spell-gem casts

findings.issue: IsEngaged alone did not detect a player on hostile NPC hate lists with autoattack disabled
findings.resolution: Require GetAggroCount()==0 in addition to existing session guards
findings.evidence: Actual handler test reproduced the failure with aggro positive, engagement false and autoattack false; corrected handler rejects before DB access

final_review: No remaining substantive blockers within the reviewed changes and contract
remaining_boundary: Native RoF2 packet/rendering, persistence through player workflows, balance and owner acceptance require in-game QA; no live deployment or wiki publication
